<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Tuhin tryl pv.</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@200;300;400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{--bg:#f4f4f2;--panel:#fff;--ink:#16161a;--soft:#4a4a50;--mute:#9a9aa0;--line:#e4e4e0;--thumb:#f3f3f0;--glow:rgba(255,255,255,.9);--shade:rgba(20,20,30,.2);--btn:#16161a;--btnt:#fff;--gl:.9;--ease:cubic-bezier(.65,.05,.2,1);
box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]){--bg:#151517;--panel:#1c1c1f;--ink:#f1f1ee;--soft:#c9c9c6;--mute:#77777d;--line:#2c2c30;--thumb:#26262a;--glow:rgba(255,255,255,.08);--shade:rgba(0,0,0,.55);--btn:#f4f4f2;--btnt:#16161a;--gl:.45}}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{--bg:#151517;--panel:#1c1c1f;--ink:#f1f1ee;--soft:#c9c9c6;--mute:#77777d;--line:#2c2c30;--thumb:#26262a;--glow:rgba(255,255,255,.08);--shade:rgba(0,0,0,.55);--btn:#f4f4f2;--btnt:#16161a;--gl:.45}
html{height:100%;scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)}
body{min-height:100%;margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font:300 14px/1.4 Inter,"Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
button{font:inherit;color:inherit;background:none;border:0;padding:0;cursor:pointer}
button:focus-visible{outline:1px solid var(--ink);outline-offset:4px}
.has-dot,.has-dot *{cursor:none!important}
.app{height:100vh;height:100svh;min-height:600px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr minmax(320px,28%)}
.main{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:radial-gradient(60% 70% at 50% 58%,var(--glow),transparent 75%)}
.main::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:110px;pointer-events:none;opacity:var(--gl);background:radial-gradient(55% 100% at 28% 100%,rgba(188,172,246,.5),transparent 70%),radial-gradient(55% 100% at 72% 100%,rgba(255,198,170,.55),transparent 70%)}
header{position:absolute;z-index:20;left:48px;top:44px}
h1{margin:0;font-weight:200;font-size:clamp(34px,4.2vw,56px);letter-spacing:-.025em;line-height:1;color:var(--soft)}
.sub{margin:12px 0 0;font-size:11px;color:var(--mute);letter-spacing:.01em}
.stage{--mh:min(58vh,520px);--mw:calc(var(--mh)*.55);position:absolute;inset:0 0 96px 0;touch-action:pan-y;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none}
.model{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:6%;width:var(--mw);height:var(--mh);transform-origin:50% 100%;filter:blur(var(--b,0px));transition:transform .75s var(--ease),opacity .75s var(--ease),filter .75s var(--ease)}
.moving .model{filter:blur(calc(var(--b,0px) + 3px))}
.model img{width:100%;height:100%;display:block;object-fit:contain;object-position:50% 100%;pointer-events:none}
.ghost{position:absolute;inset:0;opacity:.2;filter:grayscale(1) blur(5px);transform:translateX(var(--gx,0px)) scale(1.03);transform-origin:50% 100%;transition:transform .75s var(--ease)}
.model.on .ghost{opacity:0}
.fig{position:absolute;inset:0}
.sh{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:-12px;width:150%;height:24px;transform:translateX(-50%);background:radial-gradient(closest-side,var(--shade),transparent)}
.pin{position:absolute;width:16px;height:16px;margin:-8px 0 0 -8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--panel);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--line);display:none;place-items:center}
.pin::after{content:"";width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--ink)}
.model.on .pin{display:grid;animation:pulse 2.6s ease-out infinite}
@keyframes pulse{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--line),0 0 0 0 rgba(120,120,130,.35)}70%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--line),0 0 0 12px rgba(120,120,130,0)}}
.ctrl{position:absolute;z-index:20;left:48px;right:48px;bottom:34px;display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:22px}
.ico{width:34px;height:22px;display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--soft);transition:color .2s,transform .2s}
.ico:hover{color:var(--ink)}
.prev svg{transform:rotate(180deg)}
.segs{display:flex;gap:6px;flex:0 1 580px;margin-top:-1px}
.seg{flex:1;text-align:left;padding:10px 0 0;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mute);white-space:nowrap}
.seg i{display:block;height:2px;background:var(--line);position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.seg i::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:var(--ink);transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:0 50%}
.seg.done i::after{transform:scaleX(1)}
.seg.on i::after{animation:fill 4s linear forwards}
.paused .seg.on i::after{animation-play-state:paused}
@keyframes fill{to{transform:scaleX(1)}}
.seg.on{color:var(--ink)}
.seg b{font-weight:400;margin-left:4px}
.right{margin-left:auto;display:flex;gap:14px}
.side{background:var(--panel);border-left:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;flex-direction:column;height:100%;box-sizing:border-box;padding:34px 30px 30px}
.sh-h{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;padding-bottom:18px}
.sh-h span:first-child{font-size:15px;color:var(--soft)}
.sh-h span:last-child{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mute)}
.rows{flex:1;overflow:auto}
.row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:78px 1fr auto;gap:18px;align-items:center;padding:16px 8px;margin:0 -8px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);transition:background .3s;animation:rowIn .6s var(--ease) both;animation-delay:calc(var(--i)*80ms)}
.row:hover,.row.hl{background:var(--thumb)}
@keyframes rowIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateX(14px)}}
.th{width:78px;height:78px;background:var(--thumb);display:grid;place-items:center}
.row:hover .th,.row.hl .th{background:var(--panel)}
.th img{width:64px;height:64px;object-fit:contain}
.br{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mute)}
.nm{font-size:13px;font-weight:400;margin:3px 0 2px}
.pc{font-size:12px;color:var(--soft)}
.add{width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--soft);font-size:14px;line-height:1;transition:all .2s}
.add:hover,.add.on{background:var(--ink);color:var(--panel);border-color:var(--ink)}
.bundle{border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:20px}
.bt{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;margin-bottom:16px}
.bt div:first-child span{display:block;font-size:12px;color:var(--soft)}
.bt div:first-child small{font-size:10px;color:var(--mute)}
.old{font-size:11px;color:var(--mute);text-decoration:line-through;margin-right:8px}
.new{font-size:20px;font-weight:300;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.cta{width:100%;height:52px;background:var(--btn);color:var(--btnt);font-size:12px;font-weight:500;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;transition:transform .25s,box-shadow .25s}
.cta:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.18)}
.cta svg{transition:transform .25s}.cta:hover svg{transform:translateX(4px)}
.dot{position:fixed;left:0;top:0;width:9px;height:9px;margin:-4.5px 0 0 -4.5px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--ink);pointer-events:none;z-index:99;opacity:0;transition:width .25s,height .25s,margin .25s,background .25s,opacity .3s;box-sizing:border-box}
.dot.big{width:38px;height:38px;margin:-19px 0 0 -19px;background:transparent;border:1px solid var(--ink)}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.model,.ghost{transition-duration:.01ms!important}}
@media (max-width:860px){
html,body{height:auto;overflow:auto}
.app{display:block;height:auto}
.main{height:72svh;min-height:500px}
header{left:22px;top:26px}
.stage{--mh:min(42vh,370px)}
.ctrl{left:22px;right:22px;bottom:22px;gap:12px}
.segs{flex:1}.seg b{display:none}
.side{border-left:0;border-radius:22px 22px 0 0;margin-top:-22px;position:relative;z-index:30;box-shadow:0 -12px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.08);padding:30px 22px 36px;height:auto}
.side::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:10px;left:50%;width:38px;height:4px;margin-left:-19px;border-radius:4px;background:var(--line)}
}

.shoplink{margin-top:14px;font-size:11px;color:var(--soft);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding-bottom:2px;display:block}.shoplink:hover{color:var(--ink)}
.bagbtn{position:fixed;top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) + 16px);right:22px;z-index:60;height:38px;padding:0 16px;background:var(--btn);color:var(--btnt);font-size:12px;font-weight:500;display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center}
@media(min-width:861px){.side{padding-top:74px}}
.shop{padding:90px 48px 70px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--bg)}.wrap{max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto}
.shop h2{margin:0;font-weight:200;font-size:clamp(28px,3.4vw,44px);letter-spacing:-.025em;color:var(--soft)}
.tabs{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:34px 0 28px}.tab{height:34px;padding:0 16px;border:1px solid var(--line);font-size:12px;color:var(--soft);transition:all .2s}.tab.on{background:var(--ink);color:var(--bg);border-color:var(--ink)}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(210px,1fr));gap:1px;background:var(--line);border:1px solid var(--line)}
.card{background:var(--panel);padding:16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px;animation:rowIn .5s var(--ease) both}.card .th{width:auto;height:170px;margin-bottom:10px}.card .th svg{width:100px;height:100px}
.sizes{display:flex;gap:5px;margin:10px 0 12px;flex-wrap:wrap}.sz{min-width:32px;height:28px;border:1px solid var(--line);font-size:11px;color:var(--soft)}.sz.on{border-color:var(--ink);color:var(--ink);background:var(--thumb)}
.pbtn{height:38px;background:var(--btn);color:var(--btnt);font-size:12px;font-weight:500;transition:transform .2s}.pbtn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}
.rules{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(210px,1fr));gap:36px;margin-top:72px;padding-top:36px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}.rules h3{margin:0 0 10px;font-size:13px;font-weight:500}.rules p{margin:0;font-size:12px;color:var(--soft);line-height:1.8}
.ov{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:80;background:rgba(0,0,0,.35);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .3s}.ov.open{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto}
.dr{position:fixed;top:0;right:0;bottom:0;width:min(440px,100%);z-index:90;background:var(--panel);transform:translateX(100%);transition:transform .45s var(--ease);display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}.dr.open{transform:none}
.dh{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:22px 26px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-size:15px}.dh b{font-weight:300;color:var(--soft)}
.x,.rm{color:var(--mute);font-size:13px}.x:hover,.rm:hover{color:var(--ink)}
.db{flex:1;overflow:auto;padding:8px 26px 20px}.df{padding:18px 26px 24px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);display:grid;gap:10px}
.ln{display:grid;grid-template-columns:64px 1fr auto;gap:14px;align-items:center;padding:14px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.ln .th{width:64px;height:64px}.ln .th svg{width:48px;height:48px}.ln .th img{width:52px;height:52px}
.qt{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-top:8px;font-size:12px}.qt button{width:24px;height:24px;border:1px solid var(--line)}.qt select{height:26px;background:var(--thumb);color:var(--ink);border:1px solid var(--line);font:inherit;font-size:11px}
.tt{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:12px;color:var(--soft)}.tt.big{font-size:15px;color:var(--ink)}
.db label{display:block;margin-top:16px;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mute)}
.db input,.db textarea{display:block;width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;margin-top:6px;padding:11px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font:300 14px Inter,sans-serif;border-radius:0}.db input:focus,.db textarea:focus{outline:1px solid var(--ink)}
fieldset{border:0;padding:0;margin:20px 0 0}legend{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mute);padding:0 0 4px}
.db .rd{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin:0;padding:11px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-size:13px;letter-spacing:0;text-transform:none;color:var(--ink)}.db .rd input{width:auto;margin:0}.rd em{margin-left:auto;font-style:normal;color:var(--soft)}
.note{font-size:12px;color:var(--soft)}.err{color:#c0392b;font-size:12px;min-height:16px;margin:10px 0 0}.empty{padding:40px 0;text-align:center;color:var(--mute)}
.ok{width:46px;height:46px;border:1px solid var(--ink);border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;margin:26px auto 14px}.oid{text-align:center;margin:0 0 10px;font-weight:300;font-size:22px;letter-spacing:.06em}
.lnk{font-size:12px;color:var(--soft);text-decoration:underline;padding:6px}a.cta{text-decoration:none}.cta:disabled{opacity:.6}
@media(max-width:860px){.shop{padding:64px 22px 56px}}
@media(max-width:600px){.grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.card{padding:12px}.card .th{height:130px}.card .th svg{width:80px;height:80px}.bagbtn{right:14px}}
.ph{aspect-ratio:3/4;position:relative;overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:10px;background:var(--thumb)}.ph img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-position:50% 15%;transition:opacity .45s}.ph img.alt{opacity:0}.card:hover .ph img.alt{opacity:1}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="app" id="app">
  <section class="main">
    <header>
      <h1>Try the Look.</h1>
      <p class="sub">Six items, styled head to toe. Tap a pin to see the pieces.</p><button class="shoplink" id="toshop">Shop the collection ↓</button>
    </header>
    <div class="stage" id="stage"></div>
    <div class="ctrl">
      <button class="ico prev" id="prev" aria-label="Previous look"><svg width="22" height="12" viewBox="0 0 22 12" fill="none" stroke="currentColor"><path d="M1 6h20M16 1l5 5-5 5"/></svg></button>
      <div class="segs" id="segs"></div>
      <div class="right">
        <button class="ico" id="pause" aria-label="Pause autoplay"></button>
        <button class="ico" id="next" aria-label="Next look"><svg width="22" height="12" viewBox="0 0 22 12" fill="none" stroke="currentColor"><path d="M1 6h20M16 1l5 5-5 5"/></svg></button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>
  <aside class="side">
    <div class="sh-h"><span>In this look</span><span>3 pieces</span></div>
    <div class="rows" id="rows"></div>
    <div class="bundle">
      <div class="bt"><div><span>Complete the look</span><small>Bundle all 3 and save 10%</small></div><div><span class="old" id="old"></span><span class="new" id="new"></span></div></div>
      <button class="cta" id="cta"><span>Add full look to bag</span><svg width="16" height="10" viewBox="0 0 22 12" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.4"><path d="M1 6h20M16 1l5 5-5 5"/></svg></button>
    </div>
  </aside>
</div>
<button class="bagbtn" id="bagbtn">Bag <b id="bagn">0</b></button>
<section class="shop" id="shop"><div class="wrap">
<h2>Shop the collection.</h2><p class="sub">Cash on delivery all over Bangladesh. Pick a size, add to bag, order in a minute.</p>
<div class="tabs" id="tabs"></div><div class="grid" id="grid"></div>
<div class="rules">
<div><h3>How to order</h3><p>1. Choose a size and add to bag.<br>2. Enter your name, phone and full address.<br>3. Confirm. We call you to verify the order.</p></div>
<div><h3>Delivery</h3><p>Inside Dhaka: 1–2 days, ৳70.<br>Outside Dhaka: 3–5 days, ৳130.<br>Courier delivery to your door.</p></div>
<div><h3>Payment</h3><p>Cash on delivery: pay when you receive.<br>bKash or Nagad: send money first, then enter the Transaction ID.</p></div>
<div><h3>Exchange and return</h3><p>Exchange within 3 days of delivery if unused and with tags.<br>Check the parcel before paying the rider.<br>Defective items are exchanged free.</p></div>
<div><h3>Need help?</h3><p>Call or WhatsApp <span class="shopno"></span>.<br>Daily 10 AM – 10 PM.</p></div>
</div></div></section>
<div class="ov" id="ov"></div><aside class="dr" id="dr" aria-label="Bag"></aside>
<div class="dot" id="dot"></div>
<script>
const L=[{"n": "Bordeaux", "m": "data:image/webp;base64,", "th": ["data:image/webp;base64,", "data:image/webp;base64,", "data:image/webp;base64,"], "pins": [["49.9%", "20.1%"], ["51.0%", "65.4%"], ["52.8%", "94.0%"]], "pr": [["Atelier North", "Paris Mesh Jersey", 188], ["Common Form", "Piped Velour Track Pant", 149], ["Field Co.", "Panel Court Sneaker", 210]]}, {"n": "Chalk", "m": "data:image/webp;base64,", "th": ["data:image/webp;base64,", "data:image/webp;base64,", "data:image/webp;base64,"], "pins": [["54.6%", "19.1%"], ["52.0%", "65.1%"], ["47.6%", "94.1%"]], "pr": [["Atelier North", "Heavyweight Crew", 128], ["Common Form", "Washed Black Baggy Jean", 164], ["Field Co.", "Court Classic", 120]]}, {"n": "Onyx", "m": "data:image/webp;base64,", "th": ["data:image/webp;base64,", "data:image/webp;base64,", "data:image/webp;base64,"], "pins": [["54.1%", "30.7%"], ["48.8%", "71.5%"], ["44.1%", "95.9%"]], "pr": [["Atelier North", "Oversized Crew", 96], ["Common Form", "Wide Black Jean", 168], ["Field Co.", "Lug Sole Boot", 240]]}, {"n": "Harbor", "m": "data:image/webp;base64,", "th": ["data:image/webp;base64,", "data:image/webp;base64,", "data:image/webp;base64,"], "pins": [["53.1%", "28.4%"], ["48.8%", "68.9%"], ["45.7%", "93.5%"]], "pr": [["Atelier North", "Piqué Polo", 88], ["Common Form", "Pleated Linen Pant", 152], ["Field Co.", "Retro Runner", 135]]}, {"n": "Oxford", "m": "data:image/webp;base64,", "th": ["data:image/webp;base64,", "data:image/webp;base64,", "data:image/webp;base64,"], "pins": [["51.1%", "30.6%"], ["49.2%", "71.4%"], ["45.8%", "94.3%"]], "pr": [["Atelier North", "Oxford Shirt", 98], ["Common Form", "Pleated Wide Pant", 142], ["Field Co.", "Silver Runner", 130]]}, {"n": "Dusty Rose", "m": "data:image/webp;base64,", "th": ["data:image/webp;base64,", "data:image/webp;base64,", "data:image/webp;base64,"], "pins": [["50.2%", "30.6%"], ["48.8%", "70.1%"], ["48.2%", "94.2%"]], "pr": [["Atelier North", "Garment Dyed Tee", 58], ["Common Form", "Relaxed Chino", 118], ["Field Co.", "Trail Runner", 145]]}];
const PR=[[1850,1450,2950],[1650,2250,1850],[1550,2350,3450],[1350,1950,2450],[1450,1850,2250],[950,1550,2150]];L.forEach((l,i)=>l.pr.forEach((x,k)=>x[2]=PR[i][k]));const $=id=>document.getElementById(id),stage=$("stage"),segs=$("segs"),rows=$("rows"),app=$("app");
const fig=l=>`<img src="${l.m}" alt="${l.n}" draggable="false">`;
stage.innerHTML=L.map((l,i)=>`<div class="model" data-i="${i}"><div class="ghost">${fig(l)}</div><div class="fig">${fig(l)}</div><i class="sh"></i>${l.pins.map((q,k)=>`<button class="pin" data-k="${k}" aria-label="Show ${l.pr[k][1]}" style="left:${q[0]};top:${q[1]}"></button>`).join("")}</div>`).join("");
const models=[...stage.children];
let cur=0,dir=1,paused=matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce)").matches,mt;
const f=n=>"৳"+Math.round(n).toLocaleString("en-US");
function layout(){const W=stage.clientWidth,sp=W/(W<700?2.8:4.9);
models.forEach((m,i)=>{const d=((i-cur+9)%6)-3,a=Math.abs(d),jump=m._d===undefined||Math.abs(d-m._d)>3;
if(jump)m.style.transition="none";
m.style.transform=`translateX(calc(-50% + ${d*sp}px)) scale(${1-.19*a})`;
m.style.opacity=a>2?0:[1,.9,.55][a];
m.style.setProperty("--b",(a>2?8:[0,4,8][a])+"px");
m.style.setProperty("--gx",(a?dir*(10+a*8):0)+"px");
m.style.zIndex=9-a;m.style.pointerEvents=a>2?"none":"auto";
m.classList.toggle("on",d===0);
if(jump){void m.offsetWidth;m.style.transition=""}
m._d=d})}
function side(){const l=L[cur],sum=l.pr.reduce((a,x)=>a+x[2],0);
rows.innerHTML=l.pr.map((x,i)=>`<div class="row" style="--i:${i}" data-k="${i}"><div class="th"><img src="${l.th[i]}" alt=""></div><div><div class="br">${x[0]}</div><div class="nm">${x[1]}</div><div class="pc">${f(x[2])}</div></div><button class="add" aria-label="Add ${x[1]} to bag">+</button></div>`).join("");
$("old").textContent=f(sum);$("new").textContent=f(sum*.9)}
function bar(){segs.innerHTML=L.map((l,i)=>`<button class="seg${i<cur?" done":""}${i===cur?" on":""}" data-i="${i}" aria-label="Look ${i+1}: ${l.n}"><i></i><span>${String(i+1).padStart(2,"0")}${i===cur?` <b>${l.n}</b>`:""}</span></button>`).join("")}
function update(){layout();bar();side();stage.classList.add("moving");clearTimeout(mt);mt=setTimeout(()=>stage.classList.remove("moving"),750)}
function go(i,d){const dx=((i-cur+9)%6)-3;dir=d||(dx>0?1:-1);cur=i;update()}
const next=()=>go((cur+1)%6,1),prev=()=>go((cur+5)%6,-1);
$("next").onclick=next;$("prev").onclick=prev;
segs.addEventListener("click",e=>{const s=e.target.closest(".seg");if(s)go(+s.dataset.i)});
segs.addEventListener("animationend",next);
const pb=$("pause"),PI='<svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 12 12" fill="currentColor"><rect x="2" y="1" width="3" height="10"/><rect x="7" y="1" width="3" height="10"/></svg>',PL='<svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 12 12" fill="currentColor"><path d="M2 1l9 5-9 5z"/></svg>';
function setP(){app.classList.toggle("paused",paused);pb.innerHTML=paused?PL:PI;pb.setAttribute("aria-label",paused?"Play autoplay":"Pause autoplay")}
pb.onclick=()=>{paused=!paused;setP()};
addEventListener("keydown",e=>{if(/INPUT|TEXTAREA|SELECT/.test(e.target.tagName))return;if(e.key==="ArrowRight")next();if(e.key==="ArrowLeft")prev()});
let sx=null;
stage.addEventListener("pointerdown",e=>{sx=e.clientX});
addEventListener("pointerup",e=>{if(sx===null)return;const dx=e.clientX-sx;sx=null;
if(Math.abs(dx)>50){dx<0?next():prev();return}
const pin=e.target.closest&&e.target.closest(".pin");
if(pin){const r=rows.querySelector(`[data-k="${pin.dataset.k}"]`);if(r){r.classList.add("hl");r.scrollIntoView({block:"nearest",behavior:"smooth"});setTimeout(()=>r.classList.remove("hl"),1800)}return}
const m=e.target.closest&&e.target.closest(".model");if(m&&!m.classList.contains("on"))go(+m.dataset.i)});

$("cta").onclick=function(){const s=this.firstElementChild;s.textContent="Added to bag \u2713";setTimeout(()=>s.textContent="Add full look to bag",1800)};
addEventListener("resize",layout);
if(matchMedia("(hover:hover) and (pointer:fine)").matches){
document.documentElement.classList.add("has-dot");
const dot=$("dot");let tx=0,ty=0,x=0,y=0;
addEventListener("mousemove",e=>{tx=e.clientX;ty=e.clientY;dot.style.opacity=1;dot.classList.toggle("big",!!e.target.closest("button,.row,.model:not(.on)"))});
document.addEventListener("mouseleave",()=>dot.style.opacity=0);
(function tick(){x+=(tx-x)*.2;y+=(ty-y)*.2;dot.style.transform=`translate(${x}px,${y}px)`;requestAnimationFrame(tick)})()}
setP();update();
</script>
<script>
const SHOP_NO="01XXXXXXXXX",SHOP_WA="8801XXXXXXXXX";
document.querySelectorAll(".shopno").forEach(s=>s.textContent=SHOP_NO);
const IC={tee:"M16 12L24 9Q28 14 32 9L40 12L48 20L42 26L38 23V46H18V23L14 26L8 20Z",sw:"M18 11L24 9Q28 13 32 9L38 11L50 36L43 39L37 25V46H19V25L13 39L6 36Z",pt:"M17 8H39L43 48H30L28 24L26 48H13Z",bg:"M15 8H41L47 49H31L28 26L25 49H9Z",dr:"M22 6L28 12L34 6L38 16L35 22L44 50H12L21 22L18 16Z",jk:"M17 9L24 7Q28 11 32 7L39 9L51 38L44 41L38 28V48H18V28L12 41L5 38Z",hd:"M18 11L24 9Q28 13 32 9L38 11L50 36L43 39L37 25V46H19V25L13 39L6 36Z"};
const ico=(t,c)=>`<svg viewBox="0 0 56 56"><path d="${IC[t]}" fill="${c}" stroke="rgba(0,0,0,.16)" stroke-width=".8" stroke-linejoin="round"/>${t==="jk"?'<path d="M18 20H38M18 29H38M18 38H38" stroke="rgba(0,0,0,.18)" fill="none"/>':""}${t==="hd"?'<path d="M21 10Q28 21 35 10L32 7Q28 12 24 7Z" fill="rgba(0,0,0,.22)"/>':""}</svg>`;
const PH=[["Baggy Pants", "Sky Wash Wide Jean", 2250, "ph", null, [["data:image/webp;base64,", "#f5f4f9", "cover"]]], ["Baggy Pants", "Barrel Leg Baggy Jean", 2450, "ph", null, [["data:image/webp;base64,", "#d6d6d4", "cover"]]], ["Winter Collection", "Black Utility Jacket Look", 6950, "ph", null, [["data:image/webp;base64,", "#f8f8f8", "cover"]]], ["Winter Collection", "Black Wool Overcoat Look", 8950, "ph", null, [["data:image/webp;base64,", "#ebebeb", "contain"]]], ["Winter Collection", "Hooded Bomber Look", 6450, "ph", null, [["data:image/webp;base64,", "#dddbdc", "contain"]]], ["Winter Collection", "Zip Hoodie and Black Jean Look", 4950, "ph", null, [["data:image/webp;base64,", "#f0f0f0", "contain"]]], ["T-Shirts", "Web Mask Scribble Tee", 950, "ph", null, [["data:image/webp;base64,", "#737273", "contain"]]], ["T-Shirts", "Olive Print Oversized Tee", 990, "ph", null, [["data:image/webp;base64,", "#e7e6e5", "cover"]]], ["T-Shirts", "Chill Out Graphic Tee", 950, "ph", null, [["data:image/webp;base64,", "#1c1c1c", "cover"]]], ["T-Shirts", "Don’t Trust Anyone Tee", 990, "ph", null, [["data:image/webp;base64,", "#d3d7dd", "cover"]]], ["Anime Tees", "Not Zenin Acid Wash Tee", 1150, "ph", null, [["data:image/webp;base64,", "#ededea", "cover"], ["data:image/webp;base64,", "#ffffff", "contain"]]], ["Anime Tees", "Gear 5 Oversized Tee", 1050, "ph", null, [["data:image/webp;base64,", "#f2f2f2", "cover"], ["data:image/webp;base64,", "#c2d94b", "contain"]]], ["Anime Tees", "Ultra Instinct Oversized Tee", 1050, "ph", null, [["data:image/webp;base64,", "#e7e5e6", "contain"], ["data:image/webp;base64,", "#c0fefd", "contain"]]], ["Anime Tees", "Blue Acid Wash Anime Tee", 1150, "ph", null, [["data:image/webp;base64,", "#cecac9", "contain"]]], ["Anime Tees", "Chain Print Acid Wash Tee", 1150, "ph", null, [["data:image/webp;base64,", "#ffffff", "contain"]]], ["Anime Tees", "Black Acid Wash Anime Tee", 1150, "ph", null, [["data:image/webp;base64,", "#ffffff", "contain"]]]];const S=PH.concat([["Dress Collection","Summer Midi Dress",2150,"dr","#c9879a"],["Dress Collection","Printed Shirt Dress",1950,"dr","#8aa3c9"],["Dress Collection","Everyday Kurti",1650,"dr","#d8c9a8"],["Dress Collection","Linen Co-ord Dress",2650,"dr","#9aa58a"],["Pants","Straight Chino",1450,"pt","#c9b99a"],["Pants","Pleated Trouser",1650,"pt","#2a2a2e"],["Pants","Relaxed Jean",1750,"pt","#86a6cb"],["Pants","Everyday Jogger",1150,"pt","#8e9097"]]);
const SZ=["S","M","L","XL","XXL"],cart=[],ov=$("ov"),dr=$("dr"),tabs=$("tabs"),grid=$("grid");let cat="All",view="bag",order=null;
const esc=s=>s.replace(/[&<>"]/g,c=>({"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;"}[c])),sub=()=>cart.reduce((a,x)=>a+x.p*x.q,0);
tabs.innerHTML=["All","Baggy Pants","Dress Collection","T-Shirts","Anime Tees","Pants","Winter Collection"].map(c=>`<button class="tab${c==="All"?" on":""}">${c}</button>`).join("");
const thumb=x=>x[3]==="ph"?`<div class="ph">${x[5].map(([s,b,f],k)=>`<img src="${s}" alt="${x[1]}"${k?' class="alt"':""} style="background:${b};object-fit:${f}">`).join("")}</div>`:`<div class="th">${ico(x[3],x[4])}</div>`;
function shop(){grid.innerHTML=S.map((x,i)=>[x,i]).filter(o=>cat==="All"||o[0][0]===cat).map(([x,i],j)=>`<div class="card" style="animation-delay:${j*35}ms" data-i="${i}">${thumb(x)}<div class="br">${x[0]}</div><div class="nm">${x[1]}</div><div class="pc">${f(x[2])}</div><div class="sizes">${SZ.map(z=>`<button class="sz${z==="M"?" on":""}" data-z="${z}">${z}</button>`).join("")}</div><button class="pbtn">Add to bag</button></div>`).join("")}
tabs.onclick=e=>{const b=e.target.closest(".tab");if(!b)return;cat=b.textContent;[...tabs.children].forEach(t=>t.classList.toggle("on",t===b));shop()};
grid.onclick=e=>{const c=e.target.closest(".card");if(!c)return;const z=e.target.closest(".sz"),p=e.target.closest(".pbtn");if(z)c.querySelectorAll(".sz").forEach(s=>s.classList.toggle("on",s===z));if(p){const x=S[+c.dataset.i];add({id:"s"+c.dataset.i,n:x[1],p:x[2],...(x[3]==="ph"?{img:x[5][0][0]}:{ic:ico(x[3],x[4])}),sz:c.querySelector(".sz.on").dataset.z});p.textContent="Added \u2713";setTimeout(()=>p.textContent="Add to bag",1200)}};
function add(it){const k=it.id+"|"+it.sz,e=cart.find(x=>x.k===k);e?e.q++:cart.push({...it,k,q:1});badge()}
function badge(){$("bagn").textContent=cart.reduce((a,x)=>a+x.q,0);if(dr.classList.contains("open")&&view==="bag")drw()}
const openDr=v=>{view=v;drw();dr.classList.add("open");ov.classList.add("open")},closeDr=()=>{dr.classList.remove("open");ov.classList.remove("open")};
$("bagbtn").onclick=()=>openDr("bag");ov.onclick=closeDr;$("toshop").onclick=()=>$("shop").scrollIntoView({behavior:"smooth"});
addEventListener("keydown",e=>{if(e.key==="Escape")closeDr()});
rows.addEventListener("click",e=>{const b=e.target.closest(".add"),r=e.target.closest(".row");if(!b)return;const l=L[cur],k=+r.dataset.k,x=l.pr[k];add({id:"l"+cur+k,n:x[1],p:x[2],img:l.th[k],sz:"M"});b.textContent="\u2713";setTimeout(()=>b.textContent="+",1200)});
$("cta").onclick=()=>{const l=L[cur];l.pr.forEach((x,k)=>add({id:"b"+cur+k,n:x[1]+" (look bundle)",p:Math.round(x[2]*.9),img:l.th[k],sz:"M"}));openDr("bag")};
const head=t=>`<div class="dh"><b>${t}</b><button class="x" data-a="close" aria-label="Close">\u2715</button></div>`;
function tot(){const d=+document.querySelector("[name=ar]:checked").value;$("dl").textContent=f(d);$("tl").textContent=f(sub()+d)}
function drw(){
if(view==="bag")dr.innerHTML=head("Your bag")+`<div class="db">${cart.length?cart.map((x,i)=>`<div class="ln"><div class="th">${x.ic||`<img src="${x.img}" alt="">`}</div><div><div class="nm">${x.n}</div><div class="pc">${f(x.p)}</div><div class="qt"><select data-a="sz" data-i="${i}" aria-label="Size">${SZ.map(z=>`<option${z===x.sz?" selected":""}>${z}</option>`).join("")}</select><button data-a="m" data-i="${i}" aria-label="Less">\u2212</button><span>${x.q}</span><button data-a="p" data-i="${i}" aria-label="More">+</button></div></div><button class="rm" data-a="rm" data-i="${i}" aria-label="Remove">\u2715</button></div>`).join(""):'<p class="empty">Your bag is empty.</p>'}</div><div class="df"><div class="tt big"><span>Subtotal</span><b>${f(sub())}</b></div><button class="cta" data-a="${cart.length?"go":"close"}"><span>${cart.length?"Checkout":"Continue shopping"}</span></button></div>`;
else if(view==="form"){dr.innerHTML=head("Place your order")+`<div class="db"><label>Full name<input id="fn" autocomplete="name"></label><label>Mobile number<input id="fp" inputmode="tel" placeholder="01XXXXXXXXX" autocomplete="tel"></label><label>Full address<textarea id="fa" rows="3" placeholder="House, road, area, thana, district"></textarea></label><fieldset><legend>Delivery area</legend><label class="rd"><input type="radio" name="ar" value="70" checked>Inside Dhaka<em>\u09f370</em></label><label class="rd"><input type="radio" name="ar" value="130">Outside Dhaka<em>\u09f3130</em></label></fieldset><fieldset><legend>Payment</legend><label class="rd"><input type="radio" name="py" value="Cash on delivery" checked>Cash on delivery</label><label class="rd"><input type="radio" name="py" value="bKash">bKash</label><label class="rd"><input type="radio" name="py" value="Nagad">Nagad</label></fieldset><div id="px" hidden><p class="note">Send money to ${SHOP_NO} (Personal), then enter the Transaction ID.</p><label>Transaction ID<input id="ft"></label></div><label>Order note (optional)<input id="fo"></label><p class="err" id="er"></p></div><div class="df"><div class="tt"><span>Subtotal</span><span>${f(sub())}</span></div><div class="tt"><span>Delivery</span><span id="dl"></span></div><div class="tt big"><span>Total</span><b id="tl"></b></div><button class="cta" data-a="sub"><span>Confirm order</span></button><button class="lnk" data-a="back">Back to bag</button></div>`;tot()}
else{const o=order,ls=o.items.map(x=>`${x.q} x ${x.n} (${x.sz}) ${f(x.p*x.q)}`),msg=`Order ${o.id}\nName: ${o.name}\nPhone: ${o.phone}\nAddress: ${o.address}\nPayment: ${o.pay}${o.trx?" ("+o.trx+")":""}\n${ls.join("\n")}\nDelivery: ${f(o.delivery)}\nTotal: ${f(o.total)}`;
dr.innerHTML=head("Order placed")+`<div class="db"><div class="ok">\u2713</div><h3 class="oid">${o.id}</h3><p class="note">Thank you, ${esc(o.name)}. We will call ${esc(o.phone)} to confirm your order. Delivery in ${o.delivery===70?"1\u20132":"3\u20135"} days.</p>${ls.map(t=>`<div class="tt" style="padding:8px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)"><span>${t}</span></div>`).join("")}<div class="tt big" style="margin-top:14px"><span>Total (${esc(o.pay)})</span><b>${f(o.total)}</b></div></div><div class="df">${/X/.test(SHOP_WA)?"":`<a class="cta" target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://wa.me/${SHOP_WA}?text=${encodeURIComponent(msg)}"><span>Send order on WhatsApp</span></a>`}<button class="lnk" data-a="close">Continue shopping</button></div>`}}
dr.addEventListener("change",e=>{const t=e.target;if(t.name==="ar")tot();if(t.name==="py")$("px").hidden=t.value==="Cash on delivery";if(t.dataset.a==="sz")cart[+t.dataset.i].sz=t.value});
dr.addEventListener("click",e=>{const b=e.target.closest("[data-a]");if(!b||b.tagName==="SELECT")return;const a=b.dataset.a,i=+b.dataset.i,x=cart[i];
if(a==="close")closeDr();else if(a==="m"){x.q>1?x.q--:cart.splice(i,1);badge()}else if(a==="p"){x.q++;badge()}else if(a==="rm"){cart.splice(i,1);badge()}else if(a==="go"){view="form";drw()}else if(a==="back"){view="bag";drw()}else if(a==="sub")submit()});
async function submit(){const v=id=>$(id).value.trim(),er=$("er"),ph=v("fp").replace(/[\s-]/g,"").replace(/^\+?88/,""),pay=document.querySelector("[name=py]:checked").value,d=+document.querySelector("[name=ar]:checked").value;let m="";
if(v("fn").length<2)m="Enter your full name.";else if(!/^01[3-9]\d{8}$/.test(ph))m="Enter a valid 11-digit mobile number, like 01712345678.";else if(v("fa").length<12)m="Enter your full address with area and district.";else if(pay!=="Cash on delivery"&&v("ft").length<6)m="Enter the "+pay+" Transaction ID.";
if(m){er.textContent=m;return}
const btn=dr.querySelector('[data-a="sub"]');btn.disabled=true;btn.firstChild.textContent="Placing order\u2026";
order={id:"TL"+Date.now().toString(36).toUpperCase().slice(-7),name:v("fn"),phone:ph,address:v("fa"),pay,trx:v("ft"),note:v("fo"),delivery:d,sub:sub(),total:sub()+d,items:cart.map(x=>({n:x.n,sz:x.sz,q:x.q,p:x.p})),at:new Date().toISOString()};
try{const db=window.claude&&claude.use?await claude.use("db"):null;if(db)await db.collection("orders").doc(order.id).set(order)}catch(e){}
cart.length=0;badge();view="done";drw()}
shop();
</script>
</body>
</html>
